cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Heel, yes. I've taken my shoes off so he can see mine. I'll help train your dog.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Heel means walk at your side. He doesn't need to see your feet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, at your side. You walk him and I'll say heel, just as you did.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You need to be holding the lead if you're training him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll hold the handle while you hold it near his collar. You choose the route; I'll follow.
